restamped.what: obs_integral blocks re-stamped from test_rl_integral_obs.case_spec (round-2 update_law = the r2dev generator's text, fixtures/rl_integral_law_texts_20261018.json); frames re-run through the RL builders and verified byte-identical before the write

meta.what: RL_controller deploy ObsBuilder newest frames (prev_action left out: = the input prev) on test_rl_integral_obs.parity_inputs; the station's observation must equal these histories (<= 1e-9)

obs_integral.implementations: rov_rl/obs_integral.py ErrorIntegrator (training env), deploy/obs_builder.py ErrorIntegratorNp (numpy twin, tests/test_deploy_parity.py)
obs_integral.units: I_pos [m*s] world z-up, I_att [rad*s] body FLU (roll, pitch). int_att_rp = I_att / att_max lies in [-1, 1]; int_pos_b = R(q_est)^T I_pos / pos_max where I_pos is clamped PER WORLD AXIS, so a body component can reach sqrt(2) level and sqrt(3) tilted — do NOT clip or range-assert it to [-1, 1] at deployment
obs_integral.update_law: per control tick (dt = control_dt), AFTER the estimator / observation guard / goal update and BEFORE the frame is assembled: e_pos_w = clip(p_goal_w - p_est_w, -obs_offset_clip, +obs_offset_clip) per world axis (world z-up; p_est_w = exactly the position offset_b uses); q_err = conj(q_est_f) (x) q_des_f with q_des_f / q_est_f = the frame's two quaternion slots (goal-heading frame when obs_goal_frame, w >= 0 canonicalization applied); e_att = 2 sign(q_err.w) (q_err.x, q_err.y) (roll, pitch error, body FLU: + = the hull must roll right-side-down / pitch nose-DOWN to reach the goal); I_pos = clip(I_pos (1 - dt / 4) + dt e_pos_w, +-0.4); I_att = clip(I_att (1 - dt / 4) + dt e_att, +-0.8) (leak, then add, then clip, per component). Slots: int_pos_b(3) = R(q_est_w)^T I_pos / 0.4 (q_est_w = the world-frame estimated attitude offset_b uses, not the goal-frame slot), int_att_rp(2) = I_att / 0.8. I_pos = I_att = 0 at engage / episode reset (whenever the history is refilled), BEFORE that tick's update, so the first frame already carries dt e.
